deviations.compensatingControl: Freeze network-ipc-source-v0 and block claims of Network IPC v1 compatibility until the governed migration completes.

deviations.reason: The frozen v0 server performs a blocking recv() inside a single-threaded client handler; one incomplete local client can monopolize the IPC server.
deviations.compensatingControl: Apply the bounded-read follow-up patch and keep the deterministic stalled-client regression in product CI until Network IPC v1 replaces the v0 transport.
